home.subhero: We can't get anyone a visa — embassies decide. We tell you the truth about your chances, show every real cost, and do all the work with every step and reference number visible to you.
home.s1d: Requirements and fees from official sources, with the date we last verified them.
home.s2d: UK, Schengen, Türkiye, UAE, Malaysia and Saudi Arabia. We prepare everything; you see every step.
home.s3d: Visa, flights, Makkah & Madinah hotels and transport through a licensed partner — every line priced.
home.s4d: Fare, taxes and our fee shown separately. Real PNR and booking references.
home.s5d: Paste what an agent told you. We show the red flags and the official facts.
home.t1: Every price is a table: government fee, VFS fee, flight, hotel, and our service fee as its own line.
home.t2: Every policy statement links to the official source with a "last verified" date.
home.t3: Your case timeline shows every action — by our AI, our team or a partner — with timestamps.
home.t4: Nothing is submitted, booked or charged without your explicit confirmation.
home.t5: We tell you your weaknesses before you pay, even if it means you don't proceed.

different.title: How we're different
different.body: Most visa fraud in Pakistan works the same way: a promise of a "guaranteed" visa, a single lump-sum price, cash with no receipt, and no way to check anything. We built Rahbar to be the opposite.

legal.termsBody: Rahbar provides general information, document preparation and booking services. We do not and cannot guarantee any visa: decisions are made solely by the authorities of the destination country. Fees paid to us are for our work, which is itemised in every quote. Government, application-centre, airline, hotel and partner charges follow their own rules, shown before you pay. You must provide true and genuine information and documents; we will not assist with any deception.
legal.privacyBody: We collect only what is needed to prepare your application or booking. Passport and CNIC numbers are encrypted. Documents are stored privately, accessed only through short-lived links after a permission check, and deleted 90 days after your case is completed unless you choose to keep them. You can download or delete your data from your Account page. We never sell your data.
